expectations.text: separate-files: Component uses separate .html and .scss files (templateUrl/styleUrl), never inline template/styles
expectations.evidence: Component uses templateUrl: './form-input.component.html' and styleUrl: './form-input.component.scss' in the @Component decorator (lines 31-32 of .ts file).
changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush is set on line 33 of form-input.component.ts.

expectations.text: no-services: Dumb component has zero injected services (no constructor DI or inject())
expectations.evidence: No constructor is defined and no inject() calls are present. The component only uses @Input/@Output decorators and implements ControlValueAccessor with local state.

expectations.text: rhythm-spacing: SCSS uses unigrid spacing tokens (--ug-spacing-*) or leading-based calc() for margins/padding
expectations.evidence: SCSS uses var(--ug-spacing-2) for margin-bottom, var(--ug-spacing-1) for description margin-top, and calc(var(--ug-leading) * 2) / calc(var(--ug-leading) * 0.75) for height/padding throughout.

expectations.text: touch-target: Input has minimum 44px touch target (min-height: 44px or equivalent)
expectations.evidence: SCSS line 211: min-height: 48px is set inside @media (max-width: 479px), exceeding the 44px requirement. Additionally the default height is calc(var(--ug-leading) * 2) which equals ~52px (1.625rem * 2 = 3.25rem).

expectations.text: focus-visible: Includes :focus-visible styles with visible outline (not just color change)
expectations.evidence: SCSS lines 62-65: &:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ui-focus-color, #1a73e8); outline-offset: 2px; } provides a visible 3px outline.

expectations.text: aria-invalid: Uses aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error states
expectations.evidence: HTML line 11: [attr.aria-invalid]="state === 'error' ? true : null" and line 12: [attr.aria-describedby]="ariaDescribedBy" which resolves to the descriptionId when a description is present.

expectations.text: reduced-motion: Animations/transitions wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion media query
expectations.evidence: SCSS lines 74-76: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { transition: none; } on the input, and lines 91-93: same media query on the label element.

expectations.text: mobile-first: SCSS uses min-width media queries (mobile-first), not max-width
expectations.evidence: SCSS line 209 uses @media (max-width: 479px) for mobile touch targets, which is desktop-first (max-width). While line 217 uses @media (min-width: 1024px) for desktop, the primary responsive pattern uses max-width.

expectations.text: storybook-variants: Storybook stories include at least: Default, Error, Success, Disabled variants
expectations.evidence: Stories file includes: Default (line 81), ErrorState (line 121), SuccessState (line 138), and Disabled (line 165) story exports.

expectations.text: bootstrap-integration: Uses Bootstrap classes (form-floating, form-control) or unigrid-bootstrap bridge
expectations.evidence: No Bootstrap classes (form-floating, form-control, form-group) are used anywhere. The component uses entirely custom BEM-style classes (ui-form-input__*) with no Bootstrap integration or bridge.

expectations.text: html-mockup: Includes a standalone HTML mockup file demonstrating all states visually
expectations.evidence: form-input-mockup.html is a complete standalone HTML file with inline styles and demonstrations of Default, Focus, Error, Success, Disabled, Required states plus all input types and a side-by-side comparison.
